name: Research Brief
description: Research a question on the web and get a short brief: the answer first, every finding cited, and what is still uncertain.
abilities: Plans a few searches aimed at primary sources
Reads the pages instead of trusting snippets
Writes a one-screen brief with inline citations
Says where sources disagree, and which is more credible
permissions: Uses the Web search and Read web pages plugins when they are on

changes.notes: No "Couldn't verify" section: it searches again for any part still unanswered.
